description: Switch 😏 on or off for one row by its key (faceable): a faceable relay opens this node's face. Answers {key, faceable}. Switching it off on a relay also forgets the face this node holds there. Refused 404 (no-such-contact) when there is no row, and, only when switching it on, 403 not-a-relay for a row that is not a relay and 403 no-seat for a relay this node holds no seat on. Owner only: never granted, never from a face or a peer.
